question: If Evie Frye and Jacob Frye are my two commanders, can my deck contain cards with white in their color identity?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the deck may contain cards with blue and/or black in their color identity, but not white, red or green.
expected.answer: If your Commander deck has two commanders, you can only include cards whose own color identities are also found in your commanders’ combined color identities. If Evie Frye and Jacob Frye are your commanders, your deck may contain cards with blue and/or black in their color identity, but not white, red, or green.
